definition_zh: 挥舞；威胁地挥动（武器等）
definition_en: to wave or shake something, especially a weapon, threateningly
core_image: 一个人把刀高高举起，手腕急速晃动，刀光在人群头上划圈
scene: 路口起了争执。The angry driver leaped out and brandished a wrench at the other car.
sceneCN: 这里 brandish 是「威胁地挥动」（第 1 个义项：挥舞以示威吓）；句意是愤怒的司机跳下车，朝那辆车挥舞扳手。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「挥舞动作」
同根名词，古义为「燃烧的木头；剑」

senses.title: To wave a weapon threateningly
senses.definition: to shake or wave a weapon so as to threaten or frighten
senses.definitionCN: 摇晃或挥动武器以威胁、恐吓他人
senses.example: The robber brandished a pistol and shouted.
senses.exampleCN: 劫匪挥舞着手枪大声吼叫。
senses.why: The word's root means a burning sword, so the original motion is a blade made to flash.
senses.whyCN: 词根本义为「燃烧的剑」，因此原初动作就是让刀锋闪光的一挥。

senses.title: To wave something as a display
senses.definition: to wave an object to draw attention or show off
senses.definitionCN: 挥动物体以引人注目或自我炫耀
senses.example: He brandished his trophy at the cameras.
senses.exampleCN: 他对着镜头炫耀般挥舞奖杯。
senses.why: Threat is display directed at enemies; turn the audience friendly and the same wave becomes show.
senses.whyCN: 威胁是面向敌人的展示；观众换成友方，同一挥动便成了炫耀。

senses.title: To wield or flourish vigorously
senses.definition: to handle something with energetic, sweeping motions
senses.definitionCN: 以大幅度的动作有力地挥动某物
senses.example: The conductor brandished the baton through the finale.
senses.exampleCN: 指挥在终曲中用力挥动指挥棒。
senses.why: Once the motion is grasped, the threatening purpose can drop away and energy remains.
senses.whyCN: 把握了挥动这一动作后，威胁目的可以脱落，只剩力气本身。

senses.title: To brandish words or ideas
senses.definition: to use words, arguments, or documents as if they were weapons
senses.definitionCN: 像使用武器那样使用言辞、论点或文件
senses.example: She brandished the report at the committee.
senses.exampleCN: 她在委员会面前挥舞那份报告。
senses.why: The arm's gesture maps onto argument: thrust, wave, and force an opponent back.
senses.whyCN: 手臂的动作映射到论辩上：刺、挥、逼退对手。

senses.title: To display power or status
senses.definition: to make a show of authority, wealth, or connections
senses.definitionCN: 张扬地展示权力、财富或关系
senses.example: Officials brandished their influence to skip the queue.
senses.why: A sword raised not to strike but to be seen is power's oldest advertisement.
senses.whyCN: 举起剑不为砍杀而为被看见，这是权力最古老的广告。

senses.title: To brandish light or fire
senses.definition: to wave something bright or burning, literal or figurative
senses.definitionCN: 挥动明亮或燃烧之物，实指或比喻
senses.example: Protesters brandished torches along the shore.
senses.exampleCN: 抗议者沿海岸挥舞火把。
senses.why: The root's burning brand keeps its fire alive in this oldest use.
senses.whyCN: 词根里「燃烧的木头」在此最古老的用法中保有火光。

senses.title: To flourish briefly and theatrically
senses.definition: to wave something for effect in a moment of drama
senses.definitionCN: 在戏剧性时刻为效果而挥动
senses.example: The lawyer brandished the contract for the jury to see.
senses.exampleCN: 律师把合同扬起来给陪审团看。
senses.why: Display is theater; a single wave timed for eyes is the gesture's pure form.
senses.whyCN: 展示即剧场；掐准时机、面向观众的一挥是这一手势的纯粹形态。

senses.title: To brandish oneself
senses.definition: rarely, to carry oneself with flaunting confidence
senses.definitionCN: 罕用：以张扬自信的姿态示人
senses.example: He brandished through the room as if he owned it.
senses.exampleCN: 他张扬地走过房间，仿佛那是他家。
senses.why: When the object vanishes, the waving person becomes the thing displayed.
senses.whyCN: 当挥动对象消失，挥手之人自己便成了被展示之物。

intro.en: Brandish comes through Old French from a Germanic root seen in English brand, a burning piece of wood or a sword.
intro.cn: brandish 经古法语传入，源自日耳曼词根，与英语 brand（燃木；剑）同根。

items.en: A reconstructed root *brandaz meant a burning piece of wood; the metal blade was likened to a glowing stick.
items.cn: 重构词根 *brandaz 意为燃烧的木段；金属剑刃被比作发光的木棍。

items.en: Old French brand meant sword, and brandir meant to wave a weapon.
items.cn: 古法语 brand 意为剑，brandir 意为挥动武器。

items.en: The frequentative ending -iss- marked repeated waving, giving brandiss-.
items.cn: 表反复的后缀 -iss- 标记不断挥动，构成 brandiss-。

items.en: Middle English took brandish from Old French brandiss- with the sense of waving a weapon.
items.cn: 中古英语自古法语 brandiss- 借入 brandish，义为挥舞武器。

items.en: Shakespeare and the King James Bible fixed the word in vivid scenes of waving blades and banners.
items.cn: 莎剧与钦定本圣经把它定格在挥刀扬旗的生动场景中。

items.en: Modern English extends it to flags, documents, and figurative power, always with a theatrical air.
items.cn: 现代英语将其扩展至旗帜、文件与比喻性的权力，始终带有戏剧色彩。

note.en: Brandish shares its root with brand and brimstone; the waving verbs nearby differ in purpose and manner.
note.cn: brandish 与 brand、brimstone 同根；相邻的挥动动词在目的与方式上各有分工。

entries.definition: a burning stick; a trademark; a sword blade in old use
entries.definitionCN: 燃木；商标；（古）剑刃；同根名词
硫磺；字面为「燃烧之石」，同根
被放逐的；拼写相近，词源不同
浸过白兰地的；拼写相近，词源不同
放逐；拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to move to and fro, neutral
entries.definitionCN: 挥动；中性词，无威胁意味
炫示地挥动；华丽色彩更强

entries.definition: to hold and use a tool or power
entries.definitionCN: 运用、掌管；强调使用而非挥动

entries.definition: to state an intention to harm
entries.definitionCN: 威胁；可用言语，brandish 必须有动作

entries.definition: to move quickly up and down
entries.definitionCN: 摇晃；如 shake a fist（挥拳示威）

normalIntro.en: Remember brand: a burning blade is what the hand brandishes.
normalIntro.cn: 记住 brand：手中挥舞的正是一柄燃烧的剑。

normal.en: brand meant a burning stick and then a sword.
-ish is the frequentative ending seen in finish and cherish.
normal.cn: -ish 是表反复的后缀，见于 finish、cherish。

normal.en: Old French brandir is the direct source.
normal.cn: 古法语 brandir 是直接来源。

normal.en: brimstone keeps the burning-stone image alive.
normal.cn: brimstone 保留了「燃烧之石」意象。

normal.en: the wave is always for an audience: to scare or to show.
normal.cn: 这一挥动总有观众：或吓之，或炫之。

abstract.en: A blade catching light as the wrist snaps.
A raised flag says both stop and look.
abstract.cn: 高举的旗子同时说「停下」与「看这里」。

abstract.en: Power displayed is power half spent.
abstract.cn: 被展示的权力已花掉一半。

examples.en: He brandished the letter in front of the whole staff.
examples.cn: 他在全体员工面前挥舞那封信。

examples.en: Protesters brandished placards as the convoy passed.
examples.cn: 车队驶过时，抗议者挥舞标语牌。

examples.en: The knight brandished his sword until the sun flashed along its edge.
examples.cn: 骑士挥舞长剑，直到阳光在剑刃上闪出一道光。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抡着地石」——抡着刀在地上一圈圈挥（像抡石头）：抡得虎虎生风就是 brandish。

root: 日耳曼语系词根 *brandaz（燃烧的木段；剑刃）→ 古法语 brand（剑）+ 反复后缀 -iss- 构成动词 brandir → 中古英语 brandish；与英语 brand、brimstone 同根。

sensesIntro.en: From the threatening wave of a burning blade, the senses spread to showy waving, vigorous wielding, and the figurative display of words and power.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从燃烧之刃的威胁性挥舞出发，扩展到炫耀式挥动、用力挥舞，及言辞与权力的比喻性展示。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a burning blade whirled overhead so all eyes see it
core.cn: 核心意象：一柄燃烧的剑在头顶抡动，让所有目光都看见

branches.en: the blade and the torch: threat in flame and steel
branches.cn: 剑与火把：以钢与焰示威
纯动作：没有恶意的挥动

branches.en: display timed for eyes: trophy, contract, banner
branches.cn: 掐准目光的展示：奖杯、合同、旗帜

branches.en: power and self held up to be seen
branches.cn: 权力与自我被高高举起

intro.en: One Germanic root crossed into French and back, picking up a French frequentative suffix on the way.
intro.cn: 一个日耳曼词根进入法语又回流英语，途中带上法语反复后缀。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognates; the family is Germanic at its core despite the French route.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词；尽管取道法语，词族核心仍是日耳曼语。
